title: Settle the flash/full boundary from a real run with classification routing on
description: Triaged 2026-09-23 from wne's close-out (2597e684). wne left mass_threshold 0.50 PROVISIONAL on purpose: the 49-tick sample could not validate it. Run an epic with [tier_policy] classification ON and re-tune from what the done actually did. Candidate: the yoh run itself, if W1 lands first.
